Synopsis:
    Indian equities declined amid subdued risk appetite driven by escalating US-Iran tensions and rising crude oil prices. Brent crude rose to ~$98/bbl on fears of potential Iranian retaliation against US assets and Gulf energy infrastructure. Sectoral losses were broad-based, with financials leading declines. Defence and select infrastructure stocks outperformed on domestic policy catalysts.
